admin.title: On-call plan
admin.hint: Manage pools, the weekly plan, warnings, shift swaps and settings. Times use Europe/Berlin.
admin.sessionNotice: The session has expired. Please sign in again.
admin.forbiddenNotice: The on-call plan needs the oncall.read permission.

pools.title: Pools
pools.hint: A pool is one on-call calendar. Only a pool without shifts can be deleted.
pools.name: Name
pools.noGroup: No group (everyone with the oncall role)
pools.deleteHint: A pool with shifts cannot be deleted.

grid.title: Weekly plan
grid.hint: Generate shifts, assign a technician, publish or delete. Every action reloads the plan.
grid.groupMembersHint: This group's members are maintained in the group administration; all active users are offered here.
grid.locked: Started or confirmed shifts cannot be deleted.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.hint: Unstaffed shifts inside the warning window and planned shifts that are not confirmed yet.

swaps.title: Shift swaps
swaps.hint: Open and accepted swap requests. Accepted requests wait for approval.
swaps.approveHint: Only an accepted swap can be approved.

settings.title: On-call settings
settings.hint: The eight oncall keys of the specification. Empty or invalid values fall back to the default.

myShifts.title: My on-call shifts
myShifts.hint: Your planned and confirmed shifts as well as past shifts. Times use Europe/Berlin.
myShifts.icalHint: Subscribe to your shifts in a calendar app.
myShifts.icalSubscribe: Enter the URL in your calendar app to subscribe to your shifts.

errors.reasonTooShort: Please enter a reason of at least 5 characters.

errors.forbidden: This action needs a permission you do not have.
errors.invalid_request: The input is incomplete or invalid.
errors.oncall_pool_name_taken: This pool name is already taken.
errors.oncall_pool_in_use: The pool still has shifts and cannot be deleted.
errors.oncall_shift_locked: The shift is confirmed or in a swap and cannot be deleted.
errors.oncall_default_pool_not_active: The default pool must be active.
errors.oncall_range_too_large: The selected range is too large.
errors.swap_taken: Someone else already accepted the swap.
errors.swap_not_pending: The swap is no longer pending.
errors.swap_not_accepted: The swap has not been accepted yet.
errors.oncall_swap_request_not_found: The swap request was not found.
errors.oncall_decline_reason_required: A reason of 5 to 500 characters is required.
errors.swap_already_open: There is already an open swap request for this shift.
